statement: The survivor is Morgan Hale, a male Evacuee-scenario character
The game starts inside evac shelter B-19 (north of Newcastle) on Spring day 61, 8:00 AM
Ava Burkhart, Chemical Engineer, is an NPC who agreed to travel with the survivor and follows
The starting inventory holds a pocket knife, a smartphone with flashlight app, a sealed bottle of 2 clean water and a matchbook with 20 matches
The shelter's lockers and benches hold supplies: protein rations, sealed clean water bottles, a tupperware, a flashlight and batteries
Black rats are present around the shelter exit
A wooden club is crafted from a plank (found in the shelter) with a cutting tool in about 5 minutes and wielded as a melee weapon
A zombie child and a crawling zombie are about 59-60 tiles southwest near the road
Wild boars and boar piglets roam the fields and road north of the shelter and are neutral until provoked
A lake lies west of the shelter along the road
Water scooped from the lake into bottles is raw and must be boiled before drinking
Clean water is crafted by boiling raw water over a lit fire in about 5 minutes, then poured into a container
The player's plan is to secure sustainable food and fuel and avoid city threats and boars

note: picks up rations, tupperware, water and flashlight from the shelter lockers
Ava helps with the fire and crafting while following
crafts and wields the wooden club
fills bottles with lake water for later boiling
lights a fire using the matchbook
completes the clean water craft by boiling
rats sit near the shelter door while the player works outside
crawling zombie alert shapes whether to continue toward the lake
